rows.notes: Single GET to /api/v2.1/calendar/ratings/analysts; page/pageSize params exist but the fetcher builds one URL only, no paging loop. Rows come from data['analyst_ratings_analyst'] (line 440). transform_data merges item['ratings_accuracy'] sub-dict into each row (line 460), drops rows without firm_id (line 451), normalize_percent divides return/percentile/stdev/rate fields by 100 (lines 388-395), last_updated is a Unix timestamp converted via safe_fromtimestamp (line 370). No preflight lookup: analyst/firm ids are passed directly as query params, so join_needed=false. C89 splits two mechanisms the prose already carried but the label set did not: the line 451 drop keys off get('firm_id') truthiness, not a text predicate (RowFilterOp spells contains/equals/not_equals/in/prefix, none of them exists/not-null), so it is recorded as comparison_row_filter -> rows.filter_comparison beside the client_side_row_filter it shares; and replace_empty_strings (line 376) rewrites every input value equal to '' to null inside kept rows, which is sentinel_value_nulling -> columns.null_sentinel, not a filter.

GET /api/v2/news with token in query string; fetcher computes pages=ceil(limit/page_size) (default limit 2500, page_size 100) and fires all page URLs concurrently via asyncio.gather (lines 154-174), i.e. page-offset fan-out, not next-page cursor. Results re-sorted client-side by 'created' and truncated to limit (lines 179-181). Published/updated dates parsed with strptime '%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z' (line 106); stocks/channels/tags are lists of {name} objects joined to comma strings (line 111). No preflight: symbol goes straight into the tickers query param (alias line 29), so join_needed=false.

Same GET /api/v2/news endpoint as CompanyNews but unfiltered by tickers; pages=ceil(limit or 2500 / 100) page URLs gathered concurrently (lines 158-176), page-offset fan-out. Client-side sort by 'created' plus truncation to limit (lines 181-183). Date strptime '%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z' (line 106); stocks/channels/tags object-lists flattened to name strings (line 112). No preflight lookup required: one request per page directly, join_needed=false.

Single GET to /api/v2.1/calendar/ratings; a page offset param exists (line 79) but the fetcher issues exactly one request, no paging loop. Rows from data['ratings'] (line 307). Query 'action' value is mapped through COVERAGE_DICT (lines 143-147); bracketed alias keys like parameters[tickers] (lines 44-55). last_updated Unix ts converted with safe_fromtimestamp (lines 250-254); empty strings nulled per row (lines 257-261); transform_data pops the url_calendar column (line 319). No preflight lookup: symbol is sent directly as parameters[tickers], join_needed=false. | C95 unit correction: :155/:158 emit int(v.timestamp()) -- SECONDS -- and :253 reads back with safe_fromtimestamp(v) with no /1000 anywhere in the module.
